name: Eternos

summary.text: Eternos (Eternos.Life) is a 'legacy AI' company led by CEO Robert LoCascio that builds interactive text-and-voice AI versions of individuals from their recordings and writings. Its first widely reported case, in 2024, was Berlin entrepreneur Michael Bommer, who, dying of colon cancer, worked with the company to build an AI version of himself for his family.

sources.title: Man with terminal cancer builds digital identity to engage with family after death

facts.claim: In 2024 Michael Bommer, a Berlin entrepreneur with terminal colon cancer, worked with Eternos, whose CEO is Robert LoCascio, to build an interactive AI version of himself for his family, as reported by the AP and NPR.

sources.title: Man with terminal cancer builds digital identity to engage with family after death

facts.claim: The Bommer AI was built from his voice recordings, writings and reflections and operates as a text and voice chatbot; his wife tested it before his death.

sources.title: Man with terminal cancer builds digital identity to engage with family after death

facts.claim: A SABRE Awards case study states the Eternos/Bommer campaign reached over 30 million people in Germany.

connections.claim: Eternos is covered as a commercial 'legacy AI' provider in reporting on AI and immortality.

openQuestions: No ownership, funding or regulatory record for Eternos was found.
Bommer's date of death was not confirmed from the sources used.
